title: [Lean] Connect actual JSON fields to checked tables and binary charts
body:
## Coverage

Explicit author-checked context: upstream main 0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea; kappa = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918. These generic theorems do not change or establish the selected multiplication exponent.

Four dimension-parametric modules connect actual Lean.Json values to checked ordered gathers, complete owner rows, original-position call selection, and named packed-column dictionaries. They execute field/shape/count/bounds checks and ordered assignment comparison. Successful dictionary checking derives the decoded column operator, both inverse directions and arbitrary-payload cancellation.

Finite coverage: arbitrary finite dimensions, ordered arrays, repeated indices and arbitrary payload universes. Malformed/missing fields and count mismatches fail explicitly.

Conditional-interface coverage: the executable checker must succeed for the supplied AST, route decoder and assignment. The dictionary adapter checks a separately supplied auxiliary certificate against the actual decoded columns. The source provider itself does not emit that certificate. No semantic operator equality is merely assumed.

Full-theorem coverage: original artifact bytes and selected success, duplicate-key/lexical policy, digest binding, complex phases, physical executor direction/allocation, precision, priced accesses and the full multiplication/runtime theorem remain open. Logical gather is an out-of-place read. This PR does not assert full selected parsed-field or physical-program coverage.

## Reproduction

Four unchanged new sources total 31,026 bytes, with nineteen observed standard-only axiom probes and six full printed types. All four final kernel checks and independent reviews accepted without diagnostics. ACCEPTANCE.json records their exact public source identities, probes/types and scope. Detailed original evidence remains preserved with the authors.

SOURCE_MANIFEST.json and fetch_sources.py fetch and hash nine immutable public prerequisites, without copying them into this PR: eight PR1879 modules at 981afe759f7dd206188b1c1a62250c6425bcd76a and SelectedSourceSyntax from PR1831 at 542f914ca0e5df4026341d08c84385cb1a71cfdf. REPRODUCE.md specifies Lean 4.21.0 and Mathlib 308445d7985027f538e281e18df29ca16ede2ba3, fresh scratch and topological checking. These commands are prospective; no extra local CI preflight or relocated replay was performed for submission.

## Comparison and attribution

The bounded source comparison covers exact public PR1879/1831/1807/1094 heads and retained PR487/1494 interface reviews. Existing selected route tables, owner injections, gather/scatter and idle operators remain attributed to their original work. This chunk adds actual AST-format composition and claims no global novelty. Canonical exports and restricted recovery follow-ons are excluded.

James Chang with OpenAI assistance, Apache-2.0; credit to Rohan Arun's PR1094, Jeremy Kothe's T16 emitter, inherited owner/geometry work, public parser/certificate/gather prerequisites, Lean and Mathlib. Existing notices are retained.
